meta.title: UTMB 2026 — Crew Day Plan
meta.subtitle: Suha's crew · Les Houches base · Fri 28 – Sun 30 Aug 2026
meta.etaNote: Runner ETAs from pace plan, ±20 min windows. If he is +N min late at the last timing point, shift your departure by N. Always keep ≥1 h buffer.
meta.accuracyNote: All bus times from the official UTMB follower timetable (French poster, transcribed & verified). Corrected vs our earlier infographic: NDG→Chamonix ride is 55 min (not 20).

base.label: Base — 100 Rte de la Gare, Les Houches

steps.text: Drop Suha at the start, Chamonix.
Park + charge the car at Réseau eborn charging station.
Watch the start.
Drive back to base, Les Houches (15 min).
Suha passes Les Houches (km 9.1). Water point only — no assistance allowed.
Drive base → Chamonix, park at Parking du Grépon.
Be AT the Grépon bus stop. Aim for the 20:15 bus.
steps.warn: 20:30 is the LAST bus of the day on this line — treat it as gone. Do not cut it close.

steps.text: Bus Chamonix → Les Contamines (~50 min, every 15 min).
At CP3 Les Contamines. Set up: he eats 30 g here, hand over 440 g carbs for the 9-hour leg to Courmayeur.
SUHA — window 22:11–22:51. Cutoff SAT 00:00.
Return bus Contamines/NDG → Chamonix (every 30 min, ride 55 min). Buses ~23:00 / 23:30 / 00:00 / 00:30.
steps.warn: Plan for the 00:30 bus as the LAST one out. The printed 01:00 is unverified as a departure — ask a driver.

steps.text: Chamonix ~23:55–00:25 → car at Grépon → base ~00:15–00:45. Sleep fast.
Drive base → Chamonix, park (Grépon).
Bus Maison Nordique → Courmayeur (45 min, every 30 min on :00/:30).
At CP7 Courmayeur Sport Center — 1h17 buffer. (06:00 bus → 06:45 also works.)
SUHA — window 07:12–07:52. He eats 80 g here, hand over 400 g carbs. Cutoff SAT 13:15.
Return bus Courmayeur → Chamonix (every 30 min) → Chamonix ~09:15 → car → base. REST.
Drive base → Chamonix, park. (Recommended — earlier than the 13:00 you planned.)
Bus Maison Nordique → Orsières (80 min, every 45 min: 12:15 / 13:00 / 13:45). Swiss pass needed.
Orsières — connect to Champex-Lac bus (~14:30, every 30 min, 25 min ride).
At CP11 Champex-Lac — 1h42 buffer. (Your 13:45-bus plan lands 15:55 = only 42 min buffer.)
SUHA — window 16:17–16:57. He eats 80 g here, hand over 260 g carbs. Cutoff SUN 02:30.
steps.warn: Watch live tracking from noon. If he is +N min at Courmayeur/Grand Col Ferret, leave N min later — never shrink the buffer below 1 h.

legs.title: CP11 → CP13 · Vallorcine — runner 22:35 ±20 · pick ONE

planA.label: Plan A — via home (tight: ~1h20 at base)

steps.text: Champex → Orsières bus (25 min, every 30).
Orsières → Chamonix bus (80 min, every 45).
Chamonix → car → base. Eat, repack.
Drive back to Chamonix, park.
Bus Maison Nordique → Vallorcine (30 min, every 30). Arrive 21:30.

planB.label: Plan B — direct, skip Chamonix (relaxed; dinner in Vallorcine; car stays in Chamonix)

steps.text: Champex → Orsières bus (25 min).
Orsières → Trient bus (45 min, every 30).
Trient → Vallorcine bus (15 min, every 30). Arrive ~19:00.
SUHA at CP13 Vallorcine — window 22:15–22:55. He eats 30 g, hand over 190 g carbs. Last leg: 4h to the finish. Cutoff SUN 11:15.
Bus Vallorcine → Chamonix (30 min, every 30, runs until 12:30 Sun). Arrive ~23:45.
Wait / nap in the car (Grépon).
SUHA FINISHES — Chamonix centre. Be at the finish line by 02:15.
Drive home to base.

rules: All shuttles need the pre-booked follower pass (France/Italy/Switzerland zones). Passes are bought.
Roads/parking CLOSED to private cars at Les Contamines, Courmayeur, Champex, Trient, Vallorcine — the bus is the only way in.
No UTMB shuttle ever runs Chamonix → Les Houches. The car in Chamonix is the only night ride home.
Phones: offline maps of the valley downloaded; power banks charged; this PDF saved to phone.
